in_sanskrit.name: Bhavati
in_sanskrit.meaning: she creates, she develops, she becomes
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhavati is a Sanskrit feminine verb which means 'to become', 'to create', 'to develop'. This name is derived from the root 'bhu' which means 'to be'. It is a powerful name which signifies the ability to create one's own reality and to bring new things into existence. In Hinduism, the goddess Shakti is often referred to as 'Bhavani', the goddess of creation and evolution.
